decisions.reason: Strong sunk costs and public commitment from the rename and long market presence make escalation-driven persistence highly likely.
The multi-model flail shredder line's own page and visible investment continue to justify keeping it despite any early disappointment.
Although less visible, the firm's investment in the high-speed grinder segment and public commitment to material processing support persistence.
The stationary fine shredder's niche engineering costs and management responsibility keep it from being dropped as results are still attributed to temporary causes.
The green-waste grinder line fits the announced resource-saving direction and accumulated investments make dropping unlikely.
The pre-shredder line's own page and multiple models represent substantial public commitment, reinforcing escalation-driven persistence.
